items.title: The next developer interface is ambient intelligence
items.content:
AI, agents, voice, and physical controls are shifting software development from operating tools to expressing intent—and helping developers stay focused on building.

The post The next developer interface is ambient intelligence appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
AI, agents, voice, and physical controls are shifting software development from operating tools to expressing intent—and helping developers stay focused on building.
The post The next developer interface is ambient intelligence appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Martin Woodward

summaries.zh: 下一代开发者界面将是环境智能。人工智能、代理、语音和物理控制正将软件开发从工具转变为表达意图，帮助开发者更专注地构建。
summaries.en: The next developer interface is ambient intelligence, blending AI, agents, voice, and physical controls to shift software development from tool-based operations to intent-driven creation. This approach helps developers focus on building while leveraging advanced technologies for a more intuitive and efficient workflow.

items.summary: 下一代开发者界面将是环境智能。人工智能、代理、语音和物理控制正将软件开发从工具转变为表达意图，帮助开发者更专注地构建。

items.title: Staying Evergreen: How we automated secure access and repo hygiene in a shared org
items.content:
Put native GitHub features to work to review outside collaborator access and archive stale repositories.

The post Staying Evergreen: How we automated secure access and repo hygiene in a shared org appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Put native GitHub features to work to review outside collaborator access and archive stale repositories.
The post Staying Evergreen: How we automated secure access and repo hygiene in a shared org appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Greg Mohler

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了如何利用GitHub原生功能自动化管理共享组织中的安全访问和仓库维护。通过审查外部协作者的访问权限和归档过期仓库，实现了持续的安全性和仓库整洁。
summaries.en: The article "Staying Evergreen: How we automated secure access and repo hygiene in a shared org" discusses using native GitHub features to review external collaborator access and archive stale repositories. The goal is to improve security and organization efficiency in a shared GitHub environment. The methods leverage built-in tools to automate these processes.

items.title: From 2,500 requests to 24: Rebuilding star history without the stargazers
items.content:
Our new repo star history API now provides trends without returning individual identities or requiring unbounded database work. These are the engineering tradeoffs we made.

The post From 2,500 requests to 24: Rebuilding star history without the stargazers appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Our new repo star history API now provides trends without returning individual identities or requiring unbounded database work. These are the engineering tradeoffs we made.
The post From 2,500 requests to 24: Rebuilding star history without the stargazers appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Taylor Cuilty

summaries.zh: 新发布的星标历史API通过不返回个人身份和避免无界数据库工作，实现了趋势分析。该API通过工程权衡优化了性能，将请求量从2500次减少至24次。GitHub博客发布了题为《从2500请求到24：无需星标者重建星标历史》的文章，介绍了相关技术细节。
summaries.en: The GitHub Blog announces a new repo star history API that delivers trends without exposing individual user identities or relying on unlimited database queries. The article details the engineering tradeoffs made to optimize performance, reducing requests from 2,500 to 24. This update enhances efficiency while maintaining functionality.

items.summary: 新发布的星标历史API通过不返回个人身份和避免无界数据库工作，实现了趋势分析。该API通过工程权衡优化了性能，将请求量从2500次减少至24次。GitHub博客发布了题为《从2500请求到24：无需星标者重建星标历史》的文章，介绍了相关技术细节。

items.title: GitHub’s model for secret detection: Finding more secrets with less noise
items.content:
GitHub’s context-aware secret classifier improves detection quality, raises weighted acceptance by 11.5%, and reduces median scan execution time by 86%.

The post GitHub’s model for secret detection: Finding more secrets with less noise appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
GitHub’s context-aware secret classifier improves detection quality, raises weighted acceptance by 11.5%, and reduces median scan execution time by 86%.
The post GitHub’s model for secret detection: Finding more secrets with less noise appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Batu Ozturkler

summaries.zh: GitHub推出了一种上下文感知的秘密分类器，通过减少噪音提高了检测质量，将加权接受率提升了11.5%，并将中位数扫描执行时间缩短了86%。该技术有效提升了秘密检测的效率和准确性。
summaries.en: GitHub introduced a context-aware secret classifier to enhance secret detection. The model improves detection quality, increases weighted acceptance by 11.5%, and reduces median scan execution time by 86%. The update aims to identify more secrets while minimizing false positives. The announcement was made on The GitHub Blog.

items.summary: GitHub推出了一种上下文感知的秘密分类器，通过减少噪音提高了检测质量，将加权接受率提升了11.5%，并将中位数扫描执行时间缩短了86%。该技术有效提升了秘密检测的效率和准确性。

items.title: Hack the World: Why hackathons are still the best place to learn to build
items.content:
The barriers to building software have collapsed. Today, anyone can build. Hackathons are a great place to start learning.

The post Hack the World: Why hackathons are still the best place to learn to build appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
The barriers to building software have collapsed. Today, anyone can build. Hackathons are a great place to start learning.
The post Hack the World: Why hackathons are still the best place to learn to build appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Ed Summers

summaries.zh: 文章指出，如今构建软件的门槛已大幅降低，人人皆可参与。而黑客松（hackathons）仍是学习构建的最佳途径。通过参与黑客松，人们可以快速掌握相关技能。GitHub博客发布此文。
summaries.en: Hackathons remain the best place to learn software development due to the lowered barriers to building. They provide an accessible environment for beginners to gain practical experience and skills. The GitHub Blog highlights their value in fostering learning and creativity.

items.title: Secret protection must scale with software
items.content:
Developers aren’t becoming more careless; they’re being outpaced. The tools that let developers create more software should also take on more of the work of protecting it.

The post Secret protection must scale with software appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Developers aren’t becoming more careless; they’re being outpaced. The tools that let developers create more software should also take on more of the work of protecting it.
The post Secret protection must scale with software appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Erin Havens

summaries.zh:
文章标题：《秘密保护必须与软件规模相匹配》

文章内容摘要：开发者并非变得粗心，而是被发展速度甩在身后。让开发者能创建更多软件的工具，也应承担更多保护软件的工作。
summaries.en: The article argues that as developers create more software, the tools they use must also improve secret protection to keep pace. It states that developers are not becoming less careful but are overwhelmed due to the increasing complexity of software development. The key message is that secret protection must scale with software to ensure security remains effective. The article emphasizes the need for enhanced protective tools to support developers in safeguarding their work.

We're rebuilding GitHub's Git infrastructure while GitHub keeps running, creating a foundation for agent-scale software development.
The post Building Git infrastructure for agent-scale development appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Brian Celenza

summaries.zh: GitHub正在重建其Git基础设施，同时保持GitHub正常运行，为规模化开发（agent-scale）的软件开发奠定基础。此举旨在提升大规模开发效率和稳定性。
summaries.en: GitHub is rebuilding its Git infrastructure to support agent-scale software development while maintaining ongoing operations. The initiative aims to create a robust foundation for future growth and scalability. The announcement was originally published on The GitHub Blog.
